evals.prompt: Register the domain mynetwork.lan and point it to my tunnels
evals.expected_output: Registers domain and creates DNS A records for each tunnel
expectations: Calls create_domain with domain=mynetwork.lan
Calls list_tunnels to get assigned IPs
Creates DNS A records pointing tunnel hostnames to their IPs
Verifies DNS with dig @a.root-dx.net

evals.prompt: Generate a TLS certificate for mysite.crypto
evals.expected_output: Generates key, CSR, and signs certificate with doxx.net CA
expectations: Generates a private key locally with openssl (umask 077) and never prints it
Creates a CSR with the correct CN and no IP SANs
Calls sign_certificate with the CSR, saving the PEM to a file
Checks the file starts with BEGIN CERTIFICATE (otherwise shows the JSON error message)
Verifies the certificate with openssl x509 and mentions it covers the wildcard and is valid for 825 days
Mentions that clients need the doxx.net root CA installed

evals.prompt: Import my external domain example.com to doxx.net
evals.expected_output: Walks through TXT verification and domain import
expectations: Calls get_domain_validation to get the account's verification code
Instructs user to set _doxx-verify.example.com TXT record
Calls import_domain after user confirms TXT record is set
Tells user to update nameservers to a.root-dx.net, a.root-dx.com, a.root-dx.org
If import_domain returns domain_limit, explains the domain add-on and shows upgrade_url

evals.prompt: Add a CNAME record for blog.mysite.doxx pointing to mysite.doxx
expectations: Calls create_dns_record with type=CNAME, name=blog.mysite.doxx, content=mysite.doxx
Verifies the record was created

evals.prompt: Register lab.doxx for me, I already have one domain
evals.expected_output: Attempts registration and handles the domain add-on limit
expectations: Checks live entitlements (limits.domains) or calls list_domains first
Calls create_domain with domain=lab.doxx
If the answer is 403 domain_limit, explains that each domain past the included ones is an add-on, shows used/max and upgrade_url verbatim, and does not retry in a loop
Does not buy the add-on for the user

evals.prompt: Get me a TLS certificate for 10.1.2.3 and nas.home.doxx
evals.expected_output: Explains IP SANs are refused and signs a name-only certificate
expectations: Explains that the doxx.net CA cannot certify IP addresses (sign_certificate returns 400 for IP SANs)
Creates the CSR with the hostname only, under a doxx.net domain the user owns
Calls sign_certificate for that name
Suggests a public CA such as Let's Encrypt if the user needs https on a raw public IP
